brief: Help Imran decide where to live and work: NYC or SF and nearby towns within about 45 minutes of work. Another PM role, ideally working with an AI research lab. Move alone within next year; partner within a couple of years; children's schooling relevant in three years. Priorities ranked: quality education for kids and family life, safety, then frequent neighborhood activities and walkability. Housing budget depends on work. Building a business is a possibility in 5-10 years.
answer: Lead with Park Slope: Anthropic offers the role in NYC, its school evidence is the strongest in the set, and the commute has 17 minutes of slack. Switch to SF only if an offer puts you inside model decisions in a way the NYC role does not. Hoboken is the fallback for a midtown office; Berkeley is out on commute.

cover.title: NYC or San Francisco?
cover.subtitle:
Where to live and work for the next role, the family and the business after that
Decision brief for Imran · September 2026

slides.title: Lead with Park Slope; move to SF only for a role inside model decisions
slides.soWhat: Park Slope is the only location that clears every gate with evidence in hand; SF wins only if the role itself is better.
slides.source: NYC Public Schools 2024-25 reports; CA Dashboard 2025; HomeSnacks/FBI 2024; Rome2Rio; Zillow 8 Sep 2026; Anthropic and OpenAI postings

slides.title: Both cities offer the role; only Anthropic lets you take it in New York

exhibit.heading: Published annual pay for research-connected PM roles

points: Research and Core Models put you inside model decisions; Labs and API Agents build founder skills
The two OpenAI roles are SF-only, so an OpenAI offer is a reason to move west
Pay bands overlap; the role, not the salary, separates the offers
slides.soWhat: In interviews, establish which decisions you own and which researchers you sit with; a lab name alone proves nothing.
slides.source: Anthropic and OpenAI job postings retrieved 8 Sep 2026; API Agents band estimated from adjacent listings

slides.title: NYC schools beat their peers by 7–12 points; the SF pair is a preference
slides.soWhat: Education does not decide the city; it decides the neighborhood. Jefferson leads Alvarado by 3 and 11 points, but Alvarado offers Spanish immersion.
slides.source: NYC Public Schools 2024-25 School Quality Snapshots; California School Dashboard 2025. Scales are not comparable across states.

slides.title: Hoboken is safest on the matched measure; neighborhoods differ more than cities
points: Noe Valley and Inner Sunset rank among SF's lower-rate neighborhoods
Felony-assault counts rose in the two NYC precincts examined; get the rates before signing a lease
Berkeley pedestrian robberies fell from 205 to 106 in 2024
slides.soWhat: Safety is your #2 priority and the evidence is citywide: walk the actual streets in daylight and at night before choosing a block.
slides.source: HomeSnacks compilation of FBI 2024 data; NYPD precinct reports; SFPD neighborhood rankings; Berkeley PD 2024

slides.title: Every shortlisted commute fits in 45 minutes except Berkeley, which fails by 10

exhibit.heading: Illustrative door-to-door journey to a central office

slides.soWhat: Ride time is not the constraint; waiting and walking are. Berkeley's 15-minute wait already halves the published 30-minute headway.
slides.source: Rome2Rio station-to-station estimates; walk and wait times are assumptions, not measured routes

slides.title: Rent moves five points of gross pay: a comfort decision, not a viability one

exhibits.heading: Annual rent at three monthly budgets

exhibits.panelHeading: Rent as a share of gross salary

slides.soWhat: A $1,500 monthly premium is $18,000 a year; state and city income tax between NY, NJ and CA moves more than that.
slides.source: Zillow two-bedroom asks, 8 Sep 2026; salary bands from posted roles; gross-pay arithmetic, no tax modeled

slides.title: Hoboken is the midtown fallback: cheapest and safest, but its school trails its district
slides.soWhat: Hoboken saves roughly $12,000 a year against Park Slope and has the lowest matched crime rate; it qualifies only if the office is reachable by PATH.
slides.source: Hoboken Public Schools 2024-25; Zillow 8 Sep 2026; HomeSnacks/FBI 2024

slides.title: Rent for stage one, book two visits, and fix the school before entry year

rows: Rent a one-bedroom near the actual office; keep it reversible
Re-size the home; compare moving with staying larger from the start
Confirm address priority (NYC) or assignment (SF) for the entry year
A tie-breaker between equal offers, not a reason to pick a city now
P.S. 321 address priority and seats; weekday commute to the real office; two streets you would use daily
Lead option if the role is in NYC
Alvarado immersion access; J Church to the office; Inner Sunset if Jefferson fits better
Only if the SF role owns model decisions
Connors placement; timed PATH journey to the real office

slides.soWhat: Require the family fit first; among the locations that pass, take the role with the closest researcher collaboration.
slides.source: Brief; NYC DOE and SFUSD enrollment rules; transit timings to be measured on the visit
